# Coding With Mohit

> Mohit Kumar Mishra (Coding With Mohit / CWM) is a full stack developer based in India, specializing in Node.js backend systems, Telegram bot development, REST API integrations, and payment verification systems. Available for freelance and contract work.

Coding With Mohit builds practical, production-ready projects rather than tutorial-only demos — including Telegram bot automation, backend APIs, and payment verification systems, using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Telegraf. Currently open for freelance and contract work.

## Services

- [Telegram Bot Development](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): Custom Telegram bots built with Node.js and Telegraf for automation, user management, payments, referrals, and third-party API integrations.
- [Payment Verification Systems](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): Backend systems that verify UPI, gateway, and crypto payments automatically without relying on a full payment gateway.
- [Website Development](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): Responsive websites built with modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Backend & API Integration](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): Server-side development for databases, authentication, APIs, and business logic.
- [Database Design & Management](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): MongoDB database design for real user data, transactions, and application logic.
- [Automation & Custom Tools](https://codingwithmohit.in/#MyServices): Scripts and tools to automate repetitive tasks and integrate services.

## Projects

- [CWMPay](https://cwmpay.in): Flagship merchant payment verification platform that processed 40,000+ worth of real transactions across 50-60 active merchants. Currently paused for compliance redesign around a licensed payment-partner model. Docs at https://docs.cwmpay.in, status at https://status.cwmpay.in.
- [BharatPe Payment Checker API](https://bharatpe-payment-checker.vercel.app/): Verifies BharatPe merchant payments via UTR without a gateway.
- [UPI QR Code Generator API](https://payment-qr-generator-hazel.vercel.app/): Generates fixed-amount UPI QR codes to prevent underpayment/overpayment errors.
- [Crypto Transaction Verification API](https://crypto-payment-api.vercel.app/): Verifies cryptocurrency transactions on-chain using explorer APIs like BscScan.
- [Telegram Bot Broadcast & Automation System](https://broadcast-coding-with-mohits-projects.vercel.app/): Sends broadcasts and automates messaging workflows within Telegram's rate limits.
- [Telegram Channel Membership Verification API](https://verify-membership-coding-with-mohits-projects.vercel.app/verify-membership): Verifies Telegram channel membership before granting access to protected features.
